fullDescription: A high-impact, dark-themed editorial design system for creative agencies and digital studios. Characterized by a deep #030303 background, glassmorphism UI elements, and safety orange (#ff5e00) accents. Features bold Inter typography with dramatic scale variations, cinematic video integration, and smooth motion curves. Ideal for premium service-based businesses, portfolio sites, and experimental tech startups.

structured.summary: A minimalist but bold dark-mode interface utilizing glassmorphism, editorial typography, and high-contrast accents to create a premium agency aesthetic.

style.description: The style is defined by 'Inter' typography used at extremes: massive, tightly-tracked headings (72px+) vs. tiny, wide-tracked labels (10px). The palette is monochromatic (Black/White) with a single vibrant accent color (#ff5e00). UI elements use a 'glass' effect with 12px backdrop blur and subtle white borders (15% opacity) background https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260520_133010_cb9c806d-bc9d-47f1-ac4c-b1759134ec8b.mp4
style.prompt: Use Inter font family throughout. Background: #030303. Accent color: #ff5e00. Primary text: #ffffff. Secondary text: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6). Labels/Metadata text: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) with 0.4em letter-spacing. Glassmorphism: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15). Transitions: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Animation: 3s floating effect (translateY: -10px) for icons. Button hover: Scale 1.05 and background-color: rgba(255, 94, 0, 0.2).

layout_and_structure.description: A structured layout prioritizing white space and vertical alignment. Features a full-bleed cinematic hero section with an overlay grid for navigation and metadata, followed by a clean, two-column grid for content delivery.

prompts.prompt: Fixed top navigation. Pill-shaped container with max-width 1400px. Elements: Left-aligned logo (16px, bold), centered horizontal links (14px, medium), right-aligned CTA glass button. Use transparent background with 0px border unless scrolling; apply nav-blur for readability.

Full viewport height (100vh) with cinematic video background. Overlay: Linear gradient from rgba(3,3,3, 0.4) to rgba(3,3,3, 0.6). Content: Left-aligned in the center-left. Tagline in uppercase 10px font with 0.4em tracking. Heading: 72px bold, 96px line-height, -0.05em tracking. CTA: Two glass-style buttons in a row with 16px gap.

Positioned at bottom-left and bottom-right of hero section. Bottom-left: Address/Company info in 11px text (40% opacity). Bottom-right: Year/Stats in 11px text paired with a 40px circular border containing a floating arrow icon.

Padding: 128px (top/bottom) by 48px (left/right). 2-column grid layout. Left column: 48px orange (#ff5e00) horizontal divider line above a 48px font-size title. Right column: Numbered horizontal tags (01 / Tag Name) in 40% opacity white, followed by an 18px body text with 1.6 line-height.

special_ui_components.description: A translucent button with a blur effect that glows orange on hover.
special_ui_components.prompt: CSS: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff. Hover: background: rgba(255, 94, 0, 0.2); border-color: rgba(255, 94, 0, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(255, 94, 0, 0.1); transform: scale(1.05).

special_ui_components.description: Circular indicator with a vertical floating animation.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: 40px x 40px circle, border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2), border-radius: 50%. Icon: Lucide-arrow-down centered. Animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite (keyframes: 0% {transform: translateY(0px)} 50% {transform: translateY(-10px)} 100% {transform: translateY(0px)}).

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain the 12px blur on all glass elements to ensure text legibility over video. MUST: Use #ff5e00 sparingly for highlights and small interactive elements only.
